events.verdict: Covington (PHI) makes marginal contact with Jackson's (DET) arm that does not affect his shot attempt at the basket.
Covington (PHI) engages with Jackson (DET) prior to the screen but quickly disengages.
Covington's (PHI) arm is in Bullock's (DET) path during the screen, but the contact is marginal and Bullock is able to move through it.
Saric (PHI) firms up his screening position in Bullock's (DET) path and does not deliver the contact.
Jackson (DET) and Covington (PHI) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
Saric (PHI) briefly places a hand on Drummond's (DET) back and quickly removes it. He does not push Drummond on the play and the contact is marginal.
Drummond (DET) briefly extends his arm toward Embiid (PHI) during the pick, but the contact is marginal and he does not push him.
Saric (PHI) makes marginal contact with Griffin (DET) that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
RLB shows Embiid (PHI) make marginal contact with Griffin's (DET) arm during the drive but it does not affect his SQBR.
Saric (PHI) briefly engages and disengages with Griffin (DET) during the inbound.
Redick (PHI) makes incidental contact with Bullock (DET) that does not affect his SQBR during the inbound.
Griffin (DET) is not in Redick's (PHI) path when he firms up his position, but he does not deliver any contact.
Jackson (DET) engages with Redick (PHI) and briefly places an arm around him, but quickly removes it without affecting his SQBR.
Drummond (DET) makes contact with Embiid's (PHI) arm during his upward shooting motion.
Saric (PHI) cleanly deflects the ball away from Griffin (DET) during his drive.
Griffin (DET) makes incidental contact with Saric (PHI) as they both dive for the loose ball.
Embiid (PHI) gathers the loose ball and takes two legal steps.
Drummond (DET) makes marginal body contact with Embiid (PHI) that does not affect his SQBR.
Drummond (DET) makes marginal contact with Embiid (PHI) that does not affect his shot attempt at the basket.

After the successful basket by Embiid (PHI), Drummond (DET) has his left arm extended and makes slight contact to Embiid's chin. Embiid flops to draw attention to it and his reaction is not commensurate with the level of contact. Officials issued Drummond his second unsportsmanlike technical foul of the game and he is ejected. There should have been no whistle on the play for the dead ball contact and Embiid was issued a flop warning.
Bullock (DET) extends an arm into Embiid's (PHI) path, but the contact is marginal and he is able to move through it.
Smith (DET) and Redick (PHI) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
RAR shows Embiid (PHI) maintains legal guarding position as Griffin (DET) begins his upward shooting motion. Incidental contact is made as a result of a natural basketball move.
McConnell (PHI) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Jackson (DET) briefly places a hand at Redick's (PHI) side and removes it without affecting his FOM.
Redick (PHI) firms up his screening position in Pachulia's (DET) path and absorbs the contact.
Saric (PHI) makes incidental contact with Griffin (DET) that does not affect his ability to grab the rebound.
Saric (PHI) has an arm extended in Bullock's (DET) path but the contact is marginal and he is able to move through it.
Embiid (PHI) legally contests Bullock's (DET) driving shot attempt in the lane.
Bullock (DET) makes marginal contact with Saric's (PHI) arm that does not affect his ability to control the rebound.
Embiid (PHI) has an arm extended but he does not push Jackson (DET) following the dribble hand-off.
Griffin (DET) establishes a legal screening position in McConnell's (PHI) path and he gives him room to avoid the contact.
Pachulia (DET) maintains legal guarding position on Embiid (PHI) in the post.
Griffin (DET) makes marginal contact with Covington (PHI) that does not affect his SQBR.
Pachuila (DET) briefly engages with Embiid (PHI) in the post but does not affect his positioning.
Embiid (PHI) and Pachulia (DET) briefly engage and disengage during rebounding.
Pachulia (DET) dives toward the basket and does not deliver contact to McConnell (PHI) following the pick.
Covington (PHI) briefly engages with Griffin (DET) following the legal pick, but the contact does not affect his FOM.
RLB shows Jackson (DET) wraps Redick (PHI) and affects his SQBR.
LLS shows Pachulia (DET) cleanly deflects the ball away from Embiid (PHI).
Embiid (PHI) dislodges Pachulia (DET) and affects his ability to control the loose ball.
McConnell (PHI) briefly places two hands on Griffin (DET) but does not affect his FOM during the pick.
Jackson (DET) extends his leg unnaturally but the contact with Covington (PHI) is marginal.
Redick (PHI) is not established in a screening position in Jackson's (DET) path, but the contact is marginal when he extends his arms.
Redick (PHI) makes contact to the body of Jackson (DET) that affects his SQBR.
Pachulia (DET) briefly places an arm around Embiid (PHI) in the high post but he immediately removes his arm and the contact is marginal.
Jackson (DET) engages with Redick (PHI) and is in a legal guarding position. Redick briefly places two hands on Jackson, but immediately removes them.
Embiid (PHI) makes marginal contact with Jackson on the screen but it does not affect his ability to defend.
Jackson (DET) jumps from A to B into the body of Redick (PHI) and takes away his landing area on the jump shot attempt.
RAR shows Griffin (DET) lifts his pivot foot prior to the start of his dribble.
Embiid (PHI) briefly places two hands on Griffin (DET) but the contact is marginal.
Griffin (DET) extends his arm into Covington (PHI) and holds down his left shoulder, affecting his ability to contest the driving shot attempt. An offensive foul should be called on Griffin.
Redick (PHI) establishes a screening position in Pachulia's (DET) path and does not deliver the contact.

Pachulia (DET) legally contests Embiid's (PHI) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release of the shot is considered incidental.
